subject: Locking a 45m lab demo — who to loop from infra & procurement?
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@stellardata.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Locking a 45m lab demo — who to loop from infra & procurement?

Hi Priya / Tom — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: Stellar is evaluating Redwood for real-time inference on customer-facing features; main constraints are SSO, data residency, and a controlled pilot (45m lab preferred).
- Next step: run a 45-minute hands-on lab where we demo the flow, show integration points (SSO, KV cache, latency profile), and answer infra/security questions.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu May 21 — 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed May 20 — 11:00–11:45 PT

Can you confirm which slot works? Also please confirm who on your side should join from security and procurement so we can bring the right Redwood engineers. On our side I’ll loop in Karthik (platform/SE) and Marissa (AE) — and we can bring our security lead + infra lead once we know the ask.

I attached a short one-pager with highlights from today (discovery-notes.pdf) and a rough agenda — we’ll finalize once the slot is locked.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of discovery items, 2 pages)

From: Priya Shah <priya@stellardata.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@stellardata.com>, Lila Kumar <lila.kumar@stellardata.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locking a 45m lab demo — who to loop from infra & procurement?

Thanks Grace — energy on the call was good. Quick answers and availability: 

- Either slot could work; May 21 09:00 PT is preferred by our infra team.
- Please include someone who can speak to SSO and data residency. I’m looping in Lila Kumar (procurement) and Tom (infra lead) so they can validate the pilot scope.

Two pre-reads / asks from our side before the demo: 
1) A short checklist of compliance artifacts you can share (SOC 2, data retention, audit logs) — attached an initial list of questions (company-security-questions.xlsx).
2) Confirmation on whether Redwood supports SAML + SCIM for provisioning and what SSO flows you’ve validated.

If May 21 09:00 PT is locked we’ll make sure Tom + Lila are on the invite.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering | Stellar Data
priya@stellardata.com
+1 (628) 555-0147

Attachment: company-security-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet with security & compliance questions)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@stellardata.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locking a 45m lab demo — who to loop from infra & procurement?

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick reply and for the security checklist. Short responses here so we come prepared on the 21st: 

- Compliance artifacts: we can share SOC 2 summary + redacted audit logs examples and a short data retention slide during the demo. I’ll add links to those in the invite.
- SSO: we support SAML + OIDC; SCIM provisioning is supported for user sync. I’ll bring our security engineer (Mina Haddad) to speak specifically to SSO flows and audit logs.
- Infra/Platform: Markus Klein (infra lead) will join and can walk through the pilot architecture + sample KV cache sizing.

May 21 09:00–09:45 PT works for us — I’m locking that provisional slot. Please confirm Tom & Lila will attend and whether you want the session recorded.

Attached: demo-agenda.md (outline we propose to run: 10m context, 20m lab, 10m Q&A, 5m next steps).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Platform SE | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: demo-agenda.md (proposed run-of-show)

Subject: Confirmed: 45m lab demo — May 21 09:00 PT (calendar invite)

Thanks everyone — I’ve created the calendar event and added the attendees below. Event details:

- Title: Redwood — 45m Lab: Integration + Security Q&A
- When: Thu, May 21 · 09:00–09:45 PT
- Location: Google Meet (link in invite) — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
- Agenda: 10m context / goals, 20m hands-on lab, 10m security/infra Q&A, 5m next steps + mutual action items.

Attendees (Redwood): Grace O'Connor, Marissa Cole, Karthik Iyer, Markus Klein, Mina Haddad
Attendees (Stellar): Priya Shah, Tom Baker, Lila Kumar

I also added links to the SOC2 summary and the short data retention slide in the event notes. Please flag any additional material you want ahead of time. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics).

See you on the 21st — Marissa
